summary.text: Alex Zimmerman is a Republican state representative from Indiana House District 67 who was appointed to the seat in July 2023 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
Ballotpedia lists Democrat Justin Chadwick as his opponent in the general election.

paragraphs.text: Alex Zimmerman lives in North Vernon, Indiana, and earned a J.D. from Indiana University.
His career experience includes owning a private law practice and working as an attorney, a legislative assistant and a majority legal associate.
The Republican Party of Indiana appointed Zimmerman to House District 67 on July 17, 2023, to replace Randy Frye.
He won election to a full term in 2024, defeating Chad Meinders in the Republican primary and running unopposed in the general election.
For 2025-2026, Ballotpedia lists him on the Courts and Criminal Code and Rules and Legislative Procedures committees and as vice chair of the House Judiciary Committee.
